title: Adaptive Compression and Targeted Perturbation: A Unified Framework for Generalized Audio Deepfake Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.16049v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Existing audio deepfake detection (ADD) methods frequently exhibit limited generalization, as fixed bottleneck architectures fail to adapt to the heterogeneous information densities inherent in diverse spoofing artifacts. Moreover, standard augmentation often leads to a pathological robustness-accuracy trade-off. In this paper, we propose a unified ADD framework to address these challenges. Our approach integrates: (1) an Adaptive Audio Feature Integration (AAFI) module that dynamically selects optimal latent dimensions via a compression pool and a stochastic exploration mechanism, ensuring flexible representations across multiple types of dynamic attacks; and (2) a Mel-Band Adversarial Perturbation (Mel-BAP) strategy that applies targeted regularization in the mel-spectrogram domain to encourage the model to learn invariant decision boundaries. translated_title: 自适应压缩与针对性扰动：面向泛化音频深伪检测的统一框架
translated_abstract: 现有的音频深伪检测（ADD）方法通常表现出有限的泛化能力，因为固定的瓶颈架构无法适应不同伪造痕迹中固有的异构信息密度。此外，标准的数据增强方法往往导致病态的鲁棒性-准确性权衡问题。在本文中，我们提出了一个统一的音频深伪检测框架来解决这些挑战。我们的方法集成了：（1）自适应音频特征集成（AAFI）模块，通过压缩池和随机探索机制动态选择最优的潜在维度，确保在多种类型的动态攻击下具有灵活的表示能力；以及（2）梅尔频带对抗扰动（Mel-BAP）策略，在梅尔频谱图域中应用针对性正则化，促使模型学习不变的决策边界。在包括 ADD 2022、FakeOrReal 和 In-the-Wild 等基准数据集上的广泛评估证明了……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个统一的音频深伪检测框架，通过自适应音频特征集成（AAFI）模块动态选择最优潜在维度，并结合梅尔频带对抗扰动（Mel-BAP）策略学习不变的决策边界，从而显著提升模型对多样化伪造攻击的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified audio deepfake detection framework that combines an Adaptive Audio Feature Integration (AAFI) module for dynamically selecting optimal latent dimensions with a Mel-Band Adversarial Perturbation (Mel-BAP) strategy for learning invariant decision boundaries, significantly improving generalization against diverse spoofing attacks.
